envelope.description: VS Code: a Build section and a 'use suggested' action on the Repo Configuration page

body.title: VS Code: a Build section and a 'use suggested' action on the Repo Configuration page
body.summary: In vscode-plugin/src/panels/repo-config.ts render the Build rows as a section of their own (not a sub-heading of the Tracker grid), with the suggestion as the placeholder of an unset row and an action that writes the three suggested values through the panel's existing repo-setting write with the same clear-the-first rollback. Keep the shared repo-fields contract: the same key, label, kind and note per row.
acceptanceChecks: The page renders the Build rows in a section of their own with the keys, labels and kinds of the shared fixture
An unset Build row shows the suggestion as its placeholder
The 'use suggested' action is offered only when commands source is 'none' and a suggestion exists, writes only when invoked and rolls the first key back when the second write fails
vscode-plugin's contract and renderer tests pass and its typecheck is clean

tests.name: vscode-plugin/src/panels/__tests__/repo-fields-contract.test.ts: the VS Code Repo Configuration page renders the Build rows in a section of their own with the keys, labels and kinds of the shared fixture, and shows the suggestion as the placeholder of an unset row
